name: SelfTimeout
author: kirin
short: Let members time themselves out for a break.
description: Adds [p]break, which lets a member time themselves out for up to 28 days after confirming, then cleans up the command and confirmation messages.
install_msg: SelfTimeout loaded. Members can use `[p]break <duration>` to time themselves out. Enable the slash version with `[p]slash enable break`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog does not store any end user data. It applies a Discord timeout to the member who asks for one.
